name: degree_distribution
author: c1fb2ea9
description: Computes the degree distribution (histogram of node degrees) for a graph. Returns a list where each index represents a degree value and each element is the count of nodes having that degree, matching NetworkX degree_histogram. For directed graphs, degrees are total degrees (in-degree plus out-degree). Use this tool to answer questions about overall network connectivity, whether most nodes have few or many connections, the frequency of degree values, and degree spread across the graph.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.
